program: Optimized DM Prospective Prop Shadows v1
prospectiveObservationStart: first regular-market snapshot strictly after preregisteredAt
methodologicalCaveat: Monte Carlo paths describe implications of the observed approximately 250-session development process; they do not create additional independent historical evidence.

historicalEvidence.classification: historical development plus synthetic Monte Carlo; never merged with prospective observations

sampling.hours: regular market hours according to Alpaca clock
sampling.source: Alpaca paper account-level equity and positions
sampling.offlinePolicy: Do not backfill or fabricate missing snapshots; retain and report gaps.

shadows.label: Conservative
shadows.reason: Conservative scale supported by the preregistered trailing-to-breakeven historical sensitivity.

shadows.label: Static reference
shadows.reason: Low-breach static-rule reference from the preregistered historical frontier.

prohibitions: No new historical DM parameter, universe, leverage, timing, exit, reset, or risk-rule optimization.
No additional Alpaca orders or changes to actual paper sizing.
No retrospective edits, fabricated snapshots, erased breaches, or merged historical/forward statistics.
A future scale requires a new preregistration and cannot inherit these observations.
